results.detail: The facts check out. Check If Rejects Null 'No CreateRow' ends with '&& JoiningStatus != 2' (DTSX:1463-1485), and only the Create Row output has a path. The source has 'aj.gen_joiningstatus = 2' (DTSX:3417) and a no-FE Lookup (DTSX:3612-3638). The problem is the dead-code inference. It depends on JoiningStatus being aj.gen_joiningstatus. In the source, JoiningStatus is the UNQUALIFIED 'gen_joiningstatus AS JoiningStatus' (DTSX:3364) in a 4-source query (aj, tr, ac, productByCourse). The WHERE filters on the QUALIFIED aj.gen_joiningstatus. The text equates the two without stating or arguing ownership. The same applies to the unqualified 'gen_lastsyncdate' in the WHERE (DTSX:3415-3416), which the text calls the joining's sync date. Under reports/logic-verify-standard.md (Accepted forms), ownership of an unqualified column in a multi-table query is accepted only when it is stated as unknown or argued. The argument is available and should be written. aj has both columns (aj.gen_joiningstatus at DTSX:3417; aj.gen_lastsyncdate at DTSX:3361). If tr or ac also had them, the query would fail as ambiguous, and the user states the package runs in production. Note, not counted: 'נפתח Fund Enrolment לכל…' leaves out that a creation can fail (catch at main.cs:282-291). That is a runtime-failure detail, which the standard treats as plumbing.
